sources.title: RAFAELIA — Implementação Latentes e Papers — Drive GitHub V1

cursor_before: Drive canonical router revision/deterministic digest TOKEN_VAZIO; RLL bounded artifacts stable but require-current semantics not explicitly classified
cursor_after: Drive router provider_id+revision_id+previous_revision_id+export bytes+sha256 bound; RLL require-current rule classified from validator source as HEAD-based staleness gate

gaps.missing_field: bounded governance decision and fresh validator receipt for historical-pin retention or proposed re-pin
gaps.blocking_dependency: validator defines --require-current as observed producer HEAD equality with immutable producer_merge_commit; stable artifact blobs alone cannot yield SYNCED_BOUNDED when HEAD differs
gaps.evidence_needed: fresh execution receipt of validator plus explicit governance decision preserving four artifact blobs and claim boundary
gaps.falsifier: artifact mismatch, broadened claims, malformed bundle, or validator CLAIM_BLOCKED for reasons beyond expected HEAD staleness
gaps.next_probe: execute validator in a reproducible checkout with observed producer head and 4 exact artifact observations; persist stdout/stderr/exit code; prepare re-pin only as draft if governance selects it
gaps.closure_gate: EXECUTED validator receipt + bounded retain/re-pin decision; claim_allowed remains false
gaps.predecessor_lineage: 4/4 current blobs stable and 4/4 latest touches pre-pin; HEAD drift remains a governance freshness condition

gaps.missing_field: current provider object, exact 12115336-byte stream, sha256, JSON parse, PID-set equality
gaps.next_probe: search exact-size/path/move-receipt surfaces rather than ordinal aliases; reject MESSAGES/NODES derivatives as raw

gaps.missing_field: predecessor→successor receipts for 8 unresolved route IDs
gaps.next_probe: bulk-query navigation/catalog/custody registries by stale provider IDs and bind successor only with receipt

uncertainty.before: Drive router current revision/digest unresolved; RLL require-current semantics carried mainly as operational F-next
uncertainty.after: Drive router provenance depth closed; RLL remaining uncertainty narrowed to execution receipt + governance re-pin/retain decision

coverage.before: canonical router identity known without deterministic current export digest
coverage.after: canonical router identity+revision lineage+753193-byte export SHA-256 bound

memory_projection.L: router revision 299→302; RLL historical pin retained as predecessor
memory_projection.O: Drive revision API and independent exported-byte hash form two provenance observations
memory_projection.T: Drive router↔Mapa receipt↔RLL consumer governance↔RLL producer boundary
memory_projection.C: router digest proves observed representation integrity, not semantic truth; RLL HEAD staleness is synchronization debt, not scientific refutation
memory_projection.P: provider IDs, revision IDs, blob SHAs, bundle digest and receipt path retained append-only

top_urgencies: P0 RLL reproducible validator receipt + bounded retain/re-pin decision
P1 eight NOVO route predecessor→successor receipts
next_probes: RLL: reproducibly execute validate_rll_federated_claim_bundle.py with observed current producer HEAD and four exact artifact observations; record exit/stdout/stderr
NOVO: exact-size/path/move-receipt search for conversations-018.json and enforce 12115336-byte→sha256→parse→PID-set closure gate
NOVO routes: bulk-search the eight stale provider IDs in navigation/catalog/custody receipts and create typed successor edges only when evidenced
Atlas/indices: after those receipts, project object IDs into UNIVERSE_OBJECTS/CONTENT_IDENTITIES/UNIVERSE_COVERAGE without duplicating payload
F_ok: Drive canonical router revision lineage and deterministic exported-content digest closed and persisted; RLL gate semantics refined from source without claim promotion
F_gap: RLL executed current-head validator receipt/re-pin decision; RAW018 physical custody; 8 route successor receipts
F_next: RLL executable receipt → RAW018 exact physical gate → route successor receipts → typed Atlas/index projections
